derivation: of Hebrew origin (H06635 in feminine plural);
def: armies; sabaoth (i.e. tsebaoth), a military epithet of God

occurrences.text: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
